tools.name: search_transcriptomic_genes
tools.description: Literal symbol or Ensembl-ID discovery in fixed Zenodo v1.2.0 primary RNA-seq results. Returns bounded matches; not publication search or semantic search.

tools.name: get_transcriptomic_gene
tools.description: Exact symbol or Ensembl ID. Returns DESeq2 estimates for all three contrasts unless one is specified, missing values, source tables, citations and limitations. No automatic alias substitution; not a functional measurement.

tools.name: get_transcriptomic_pathways
tools.description: Search frozen pathway identifiers by literal substring (spaces become underscores). Returns all FGSEA variants and BOTH CAMERA settings where tested, including nonsignificant results. Paginate at most five pathways per call. Not independent replication.

tools.name: get_transcriptomic_robustness
tools.description: Complete imported CAMERA tables for both settings, all ten Bayesian model summaries and diagnostics, alias sensitivity, exploratory DNA-maintenance or targeted redox results. topic defaults to all. Includes negative results and scientific limitations; no model fitting.

tools.name: get_transcriptomic_provenance
tools.description: Fixed Zenodo DOI, archive checksums, analysis commit, source-table checksums, field definitions, pooled sample design and attribution/licence notices. Separate from the live publication database; updates require a reviewed snapshot deployment.
